children.game_version: simplified foot tapping game with ribbon passing

seniors.counts: simplified to basic right heel taps
seniors.tempo_and_range: reduced tempo and smaller foot movements recommended

movement_profile.difficulty: Intermediate due to precise footwork and coordination
movement_profile.footwork: Intricate zapateado emphasizing right heel, performed to fast binary rhythm
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Danced in couples, sometimes multiple couples; space used for footwork and ribbon tying
movement_profile.partnering: Couples coordinate to tie and toss ribbon knot with feet
movement_profile.posture: Straight, erect posture similar to Irish jigs

signature_moves.description: Dancers use their feet to tie a large red ribbon into a lover's knot on the floor
signature_moves.name: Ribbon knot tying

signature_moves.description: The tied ribbon knot is tossed into the air as a climax of the dance
signature_moves.name: Ribbon toss

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Lively, brisk tempo matching music's fast binary rhythm
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid disrespecting the symbolic ribbon tying; do not improvise offensive lyrics in social settings

music_profile.musical_form: Simple verse-chorus with I-IV-V chord progression
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Ostinato pattern with arpeggiated bass and rhythmic strumming
music_profile.sound_description: Fast, rhythmic strumming and arpeggiated harp lines create a lively binary rhythm supporting intricate, percussive footwork; vocals are spirited and often improvised.
music_profile.tempo_bpm: fast (exact bpm not described in sources)

basic_steps: Perform zapateado footwork emphasizing right heel
Practice tying a large ribbon into a knot using feet
Maintain fast, binary rhythm foot taps
Coordinate with partner to toss the tied ribbon into the air
teaching.formation: Couples (man and woman), sometimes multiple couples dancing together
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with mastering zapateado footwork and posture; arm and torso movements are not detailed in sources.
